title: Summit Flight Earning Posting Standard
content:
This standard governs how a flown Crestline coupon earns in the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program.

## 1. What earns

Every flown Crestline coupon on a ticket that names the membership earns award miles and qualifying dollars on the segment's **eligible fare**, which is the base fare share of the segment excluding government taxes.

Award tickets, companion tickets paid with a companion certificate, and tickets paid entirely with a Crestline credit that itself came from a voucher earn neither award miles nor qualifying dollars on the segments they pay for.

## 2. Award miles

The award miles of a flown coupon are the eligible fare multiplied by the award miles per dollar of the tier the member held on the flight date, rounded to the nearest whole mile (the base miles), plus the fare brand's premium cabin bonus percent from the Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand charter applied to those base miles. That charter's premium cabin bonus percent is the bonus award miles on a flown coupon of the fare brand, as a percent of the base award miles.

*Worked figure on hypothetical inputs:* an eligible fare of 318.70 USD for a member whose tier on the flight date earns 7 award miles per dollar gives 2230.9, rounded to 2231 base miles; a hypothetical premium cabin bonus percent of 50 on that fare brand adds 50 percent of 2231 to the base miles.

## 3. Qualifying dollars

The qualifying dollars of a flown coupon are the eligible fare multiplied by the fare brand's status credit percent from the Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand charter, taken as a percentage, rounded to the cent. That charter's status credit percent is the share of the segment fare counted as Summit qualifying dollars when the coupon is flown.

*Worked figure on hypothetical inputs:* an eligible fare of 318.72 USD on a fare brand whose status credit percent is taken as 125 gives 398.40 USD of qualifying dollars.

## 4. Posting conditions

- Accrual posts only to a membership whose status is enrolled, active or dormant; the membership's status on record decides.
- Each flown segment is credited once. A segment already credited by flight accrual or retro credit, identified by its ticket and segment number on the membership's activity, is never credited again.
- Posting any accrual sets the membership's latest activity date and makes an enrolled or dormant membership active.

| Membership status | Accrual posts |
|---|---|
| Enrolled | Yes, and the membership becomes active |
| Active | Yes |
| Dormant | Yes, and the membership becomes active |
| Closed | No |
